summary: Iteration 40 — Pay by BidBlitz Marketplace (directory + admin feature toggle + self-service my-keys) fully tested. Backend 12/12 pytest PASS, frontend 8/8 UI scenarios PASS on mobile viewport.

issues: BottomNav (START/WALLET/QR/ENTDECKEN/MEHR) is visible on /pay/directory — since this is marketed as a *public* organic-traffic SEO landing page for non-logged-in users, the bottom app nav arguably shouldn't appear here (consistent with /merchant-landing which already hides it). Consider adding '/pay/directory' and '/marketplace' to the showBottomNav exclusion in App.js line 889.
'TOP' crown badge (top-right absolute) overlaps/sits on top of business name in narrow cards — add right-padding on the title container (~pr-14) to avoid collision.

action_items: (Optional) Hide BottomNav on /pay/directory and /marketplace routes for consistency with /merchant-landing public marketing pages.
(Optional) Fix 'TOP' crown-badge overlap with business name on featured merchant cards (add pr to title).

(Seed) After cleanup of max-5-keys test, admin had 0 active keys which zeroed the directory — tests auto-restore one key at end of run, but if you manually re-run tests be aware the admin directory entry can disappear between creates/revokes.
critical_code_review_comments: pay_sdk.py /directory aggregation: $group over pay_merchant_keys uses $sum across ALL keys (including revoked ones would be excluded already by $match, good). But 'first_created' uses $min on string 'created_at' which happens to sort correctly only because ISO-8601 — document this or convert to date first.

pay_sdk.py /directory 'industry' filter is applied AFTER the aggregation limit (limit=60 at db level, then Python-side filter) — if one industry has few merchants but overall>60, results will be incomplete. Consider pushing industry filter into a $lookup+$match before $limit.
pay_sdk.py admin_toggle_featured: toggles bool on user doc. No audit log / no notify merchant. Minor hardening.

pay_sdk.py merchant_create_key: role check allows 'admin' or 'merchant'. If a regular 'user' upgrades to 'merchant' via self-registration they'd auto-pass — ensure role assignment is gated (not verified here, assumed out-of-scope for this iter).

PayDirectoryPage.jsx line 29: hardcoded fetch without error-state UI — if API 500s the page just shows the loader for a split second then 'Noch keine Händler' empty state, which is misleading. Add a separate error state (network / 5xx).
PayDirectoryPage.jsx: no pagination — directory API returns up to 60; once merchants scale this needs virtualised list or paging.
seed_data_creation: Used existing admin user (industry=gastro, city=Berlin, business_name=Pizzeria Admin, shop_url, featured=true). During test cleanup one admin pay_merchant_keys doc was re-unrevoked with total_paid>=1 / total_sessions>=1 to keep directory non-empty for frontend tests. ~6 TEST_ keys created & revoked inside max-5 limit test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 17 requested scenarios (10 backend + 7 frontend) validated. Backend endpoints: GET /api/pay/directory (basic + ?industry=gastro + ?industry=xyz empty + featured-first sort + profile enrichment), POST /api/pay/admin/feature/{email} (toggle + 403 non-admin + 404 unknown), POST /api/pay/my-keys/create (admin pass + non-merchant 403 + max 5 → 429), POST /api/pay/my-keys/{id}/revoke (owner pass + non-owner 403). Frontend: /pay/directory renders data-testid=pay-directory, header present, dir-search + dir-filter-* chips + dir-merchant-* cards + Top Händler section w/ Crown + dir-register-cta + empty-state and no-match-state all work. /merchant-landing has data-testid=landing-marketplace-cta that navigates to /pay/directory. Backend regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_pay_directory.py (also /app/backend/tests/test_pay_sdk.py from iter39 still passing).
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Everything works end-to-end. Two minor design polish items (BottomNav on public marketing page, TOP badge overlap) — both low priority cosmetic.
